speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The combination of prematurity (32 weeks), maternal gestational diabetes, cesarean delivery, and the clinical picture of respiratory acidosis with hypoxemia strongly suggests surfactant deficiency. The chest X-ray will likely confirm the diagnosis by showing a ground-glass appearance with air bronchograms.
